metadata.title: Create-IntuneRemediation
metadata.description:
Create-IntuneRemediation scaffolds a local VS Code Workspace project structure for Microsoft Intune remediation development.
It creates a dedicated workspace folder under your Documents directory, sets up a standard scripts folder and scratch testing area, and generates a Visual Studio Code workspace with ready-to-use tasks for creating example files, troubleshooting remediation issues, downloading helper scripts, and running PowerShell analysis.
This script is designed to save time for administrators and engineers who want a consistent starting point for authoring, validating, and troubleshooting Intune detection and remediation scripts without manually setting up the project structure each time.
The generated workspace includes example templates and workflow automation to help you get productive quickly.

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.
